metric_families.label: Trust proxy
metric_families.description: Behavioral reliance on AI — acceptance rate of AI suggestions

metric_families.label: Human-centeredness
metric_families.description: Normalized response time proxy for cognitive load

metric_families.label: Effort loss
metric_families.description: Overhead relative to baseline task time without AI

metric_families.label: Adaptability
metric_families.description: Change in accuracy over the session — learning or degradation

metric_families.label: Interaction frequency
metric_families.description: Rate of human-AI interaction events per unit time

metric_families.label: Surrogate similarity
metric_families.description: 1 - sqrt(JSD) between surrogate and real action distributions
